title: How many distinct instance display names (1) have an average memory greater
question: How many distinct instance display names (1) have an average memory greater than the overall average among instances in the 'shelved_offloaded' VM state, and (2) have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type' (with variance categorized against the overall variance benchmark)? Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each display name as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_VARIANCE' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE'.

prediction.sql:
WITH shelved_instances AS (
  SELECT i.display_name, i.memory_mb
  FROM instances i
  WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded'
),
overall_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(memory_mb) AS overall_avg_memory,
    VAR_SAMP(memory_mb) AS overall_variance
  FROM shelved_instances
),
qualifying_instances AS (
  SELECT i.display_name, i.memory_mb
  FROM instances i
  JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded'
    AND ism.`key` = 'image_image_type'
),
per_name_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    display_name,
    AVG(memory_mb) AS avg_memory,
    VAR_SAMP(memory_mb) AS memory_variance
  FROM qualifying_instances
  GROUP BY display_name
)
SELECT 
  pns.display_name,
  CASE 
    WHEN pns.memory_variance >= 1.5 * os.overall_variance THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE'
    WHEN pns.memory_variance <= 0.5 * os.overall_variance THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE'
    ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE'
  END AS variance_category
FROM per_name_stats pns
CROSS JOIN overall_stats os
WHERE pns.avg_memory > os.overall_avg_memory
